# arin_irr_aut_num (Resource)

An IRR aut-num object carrying the AS description and routing policy.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `as_name` (String)
- `as_number` (Number)
- `descriptions` (List of String)

### Optional

- `defaults` (List of String) default policy lines.
- `exports` (List of String) export policy lines.
- `imports` (List of String) import policy lines.
- `mp_defaults` (List of String) mp-default policy lines.
- `mp_exports` (List of String) mp-export policy lines.
- `mp_imports` (List of String) mp-import policy lines.
- `remarks` (List of String) Remarks lines.

### Read-Only

- `admin_pocs` (Set of String) Admin POC handles. System generated by ARIN from
  the org.
- `created` (String)
- `last_modified` (String)
- `member_of` (Set of String) Parent as-set names. Server derived.
- `org_handle` (String)
- `routing_pocs` (Set of String) Routing POC handles. System generated by ARIN
  from the org.
- `tech_pocs` (Set of String) Tech POC handles. System generated by ARIN from
  the org.
